Topic.label: The Geometric Meaning of k in Inverse Proportional Functions

Question: Point \(P\) lies on the graph of the inverse proportional function \(y=k/x\), whose graph lies in the second and fourth quadrants. \(PA\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis at \(A\), and the area of \(\triangle POA\) is 4. Find the value of \(k\).
Solution: \(S_{\triangle POA}=|k|/2=4\), so \(|k|=8\). The graph lies in the second and fourth quadrants, so \(k<0\). Therefore, \(k=-8\).
